title: Converting Lines per mm to Spacing
text: The spacing d is the reciprocal of the number of lines per unit length. d = 1/(lines per mm) = 1/500 mm = 0.002 mm.

title: Converting to Metres
text: d = 0.002 mm = 0.002 x 10^-3 m = 2 x 10^-6 m = 2 micrometres. This spacing is only about 4 times the wavelength of visible light.
